lessons.name: third_finger_anchor
lessons.title: Third Finger Anchor
lessons.instructions: Find the position with the third finger first: right hand 3 on E4, left hand 3 on E3. Let the other fingers settle on their keys. Play only the third finger — four times, then rest a bar and repeat.
tips: Finger 3 stands tall in the middle of the hand; keep it curved.
The other four fingers stay resting on their keys, not lifted.
Drop the weight of the arm into the key; do not poke.

lessons.name: third_finger_neighbours
lessons.title: Third Finger and Its Neighbours
lessons.instructions: The third finger steps to each neighbour and comes home: 3-2-3, 3-4-3. Same shape in the left hand, where finger 2 is on F3 and finger 4 on D3.
tips: Keep finger 3 close to the key while 2 or 4 plays.
Wrist stays level; only the fingers move.

lessons.name: third_finger_skips
lessons.title: Third Finger Skips
lessons.instructions: Skips from the third finger to the thumb and to the little finger: 3-1-3-5. Each skip jumps over one key. Then the same in the left hand: 3-5-3-1.
tips: A skip is two keys apart; feel the distance in the hand before you play.
Thumb plays on its side, not flat.
Practise the left hand alone first (hands selector), then together.

lessons.name: third_finger_tune
lessons.title: Little Tune Around Finger 3
lessons.instructions: A small waltz that starts and ends on the third finger. Count 1-2-3 and lean gently on beat one. The left hand plays one note per bar, held for all three beats.
tips: Every phrase begins on finger 3 — find it before you start.
The dotted half note gets three counts: hold it.
Slow the tempo down until it is easy, then move the slider up.
